plan.title: Single-stage forward auction with mandatory terms acceptance

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX/event creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the event as a single-stage forward auction with whole-lot awarding.
Provide the required event title.
Select the forward auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Verify the requested delivery location was selected.

args.goal: On the buyer's Terms & Conditions screen, add two clauses to this single-stage auction, mark all clauses mandatory, save the configuration, and stop when the screen shows the mandatory terms configuration saved

steps.note: Configure the two mandatory terms, which requires buyer-side screen interaction not covered by a dedicated domain step.
Add one QA vendor to the auction.
Commit the required 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured auction.
Verify the auction reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the auction's vendor bid sheet.
Confirm the vendor portal displays the terms section before bidding.

args.need: accept every mandatory Terms and Conditions clause in the vendor portal for this auction

steps.note: The catalog cannot directly enumerate and verify acceptance of every vendor-side clause.
Submit the vendor's bid of 100 after the mandatory clauses have been accepted.
Verify the vendor bid was accepted and the round is marked Submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's responses view where bid and terms acceptance status is shown.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the buyer sees the expected terms-acceptance status for the bidding vendor.
